, to design effective learning strategies for mobile learning activities, the following aspects should be considered: (1) the learning strategies should be designed according to the learning objectives; (2) the learning strategies need to be adjusted according to the learning contexts; and (3) the learning strategies may be adjusted based on the students’ cognitive loads and learning achievements.

mobile learning activities should be designed with the students’ cognitive loads and learning achievements taken into consideration.
